card.name: Divisors in dose calculations
card.fires_on: The divisor right after a divide sign, the word divided by, or a slash in a formula, mostly the number 2 or two. It is strongest in dose-volume calculations.

modes.label: Divided by two
modes.description: The number or word two after 'divided by' or 'divide by' when splitting a daily dose.
modes.example: Divide the total daily dose by<< two>> and administer every 12 hours.

modes.label: Divisor after ÷ or slash
modes.description: The digit after a division sign or slash in a formula, often the start of a concentration like 2.2 mg/mL.
modes.example: × Weight-based dosage (mg/kg) ÷ <<2>>.2 mg/mL = mL dose to
